name: Hatsumei Patent Attorneys
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a patent and trademark attorney firm that works with inventors and growing companies: stone-white and white ground, ink text, one patent-blue band and olive-grey labels, EB Garamond over Schibsted Grotesk. The home page opens on an attorney and an engineer over a prototype in a chamfered polygon frame, with a centred brand over a centred menu and a deep blue band carrying a chapter counter; then the firm in three paragraphs, the attorneys by name, four practice areas as a numbered index, how we work as a strip of chamfered photographs and shaped notes, six photographed chapters from idea to patent on an uneven shelf, fixed fees in one plain table, notes for inventors and a closing photograph over the blue band. Every inner page keeps the front page's look: its head photograph and main photographs are cut into the same chamfered polygons with bracketed numerals (001), (002)… in the caption, and journal cards get plainer one-corner chamfers. With Practice areas, From idea to patent, Attorneys, First meeting, Fees, About, Notes, Contact and Journal. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
